scope: Dataset selection judgments for clinical schema mapping and source-faithful extraction. Relevance, acquisition priority, file completeness, rights and benchmark readiness are independent.

default.reason: No source-specific evidence yet establishes a new capability beyond held sources. Inspect exact dictionaries before selection.
default.action: Keep metadata only; promote only for a defined validation gap and a reviewed minimal package.

mapping_references.reason: Clinical schema/term/reference material directly tests semantic mapping; reference quality and source-only isolation still require review.

clinical_sources.reason: Clinical tables can test native schema, keys, values and time; independent mapping/extraction gold is not established for the whole source.

synthetic_controls.reason: Useful format/ETL software controls; generated/Pilot-related data do not establish independent real-world clinical validity.

tabular_controls.reason: Clinical prediction/ARFF table provides schema stress only; lacks a paired harmonization or patient-event extraction oracle.

standards_and_methods.reason: Standards, conversion code, conformance or methods material supports components but is not itself a complete patient extraction benchmark.

metadata_only.reason: Documentation is useful for deciding which trial package to request; participant and paired output files remain absent.

excluded.reason: Redundant mirror or aggregate/nonclinical use case does not meet the current dataset-selection objective.

proposed_minimum_for_requests: Nonpatient dictionary/term list, context and keys/time definitions, adjudicated reference/derivation rules, exact candidate/source releases, split/exclusion/adjudication ledger and applicable use terms. Participant records only when the chosen event-level validation actually requires them.
full_size_policy: Full provider corpus size unknown unless exact release/member evidence establishes it. Local associated downloads are not the complete corpus, participant count or incremental storage requirement.

reference_contracts.D04: Native clinical CSV inputs; OMOP demo CSVs are a separate representation, not a verified release-matched event oracle. Existing 24-case developer references are not independent held-out clinical gold.
reference_contracts.D05: Source schema CSV, separate target schema CSV and withheld source-field→target-field correspondences. Schema mapping only, not patient-event gold.
reference_contracts.D06: Three prepared OMAP source CSVs; separately held correspondence/target workbooks. Published/local pair count and source rights remain unresolved.
reference_contracts.FCN_MAPPING: First DOCX table: variable description, concept name/description, concept group and source study. Isolate source descriptions from hidden concept labels; other two tables are model results, not new cases.
reference_contracts.ADHTEB_CDM: CSV combines target definitions and source-cohort/OMOP/CURIE mapping answers. Source dictionaries are separate public CSV subsets. Blind answer-bearing fields before discovery.
reference_contracts.CDM_FHIR_EVAL: ZIP: four set-assignment inputs named CSV, prompt, and 12 XLSX workbooks containing gold and prior model-result sheets. Source/gold/results require separate reviewed adapters.
reference_contracts.SCOTTISH_LAB_REF: Sectioned CSV source profiles, unit-transformation rules and Read→SNOMED crosswalk. No patient-level expected output; retain identifiers lexically and ambiguous rules unscored.
reference_contracts.AIREADI_PUBLIC: Public CSV mixes question/answer/unit source metadata, target concepts and exact/close/broad relations. Separate target labels, relation classes and source context; incomplete/custom targets require explicit scoring.
reference_contracts.UCUM_TESTS: XML unit definitions and XML expected-outcome functional cases. Unit conformance only; section-scoped case identifiers, not clinical event mappings.
reference_contracts.CDE_HF: Requested source CDE dictionary + separately withheld component mappings, vocabulary release and splits. Exact package not obtained.
reference_contracts.SONAR_REFERENCE: DOCX method/concept/performance tables held. Complete source-variable labels/distribution vectors and splits are absent.
reference_contracts.GDC_SM: Author TAR contains ten source/target/groundtruth CSV sets; Zenodo ZIP contains a different annotation version and GDC target. Do not merge incompatible labels or treat prepared CSVs as verified original workbook reconstructions.
reference_contracts.D01: 31 native SDTM-domain CSVs and 31 supplied OMOP CSVs. DM has 400 input rows versus 306 OMOP persons; measurement/drug_exposure outputs are empty. Resolve filters and versions before paired scoring; inherited Pilot rights remain unresolved.
reference_contracts.CDISC_PILOT: 22 native SDTM XPT tables; cdisc_sdtm_ready has 21 untouched XPTs plus one explicit Windows-1252→UTF-8 TS CSV projection. Ten supplied ADaM XPTs are analysis derivations, not OMOP gold. Broad XPT conversion was abandoned after a numeric reader disagreement; originals and masks are retained.
reference_contracts.D03: R object packages and CSV projections contain raw-like, SDTM and ADaM examples with mixed lineage. Five raw-like inputs are not fully paired to the 64 supplied SDTM outputs. Only the three separately cleared generated response CSVs are source inputs; they cannot also be their own gold. Pilot-derived and CoEQ components retain separate restrictions.
reference_contracts.D07: Native synthetic relational CSV source tables plus a supplied OMOP tutorial representation. Useful for exact software joins and event-format controls; the supplied target/vocabularies have separate rights and are not independent real-clinical truth.
reference_contracts.D11: 25 harmonized CTN-0094 R objects projected to CSV; native who person keys, project and relative-day when values. R types/attributes and NA masks stay in sidecars. The three original trials are not acquired or proven release/row-matched; no independent OMOP/event gold.
reference_contracts.D47: Original gzip NDJSON FHIR resources and separately recorded scalar-path projections. FHIR links, specimen scope and absent/null distinctions matter. Not release-matched to native MIMIC demos; prior nonblood candidates remain unapproved.
reference_contracts.RICU_DEMOS: Native mimic.demo/eicu.demo R packages contain FST tables and concept definitions. Later versioned CSV views are separate derived inputs, not a binary/type/floating-point equivalence guarantee. Published concept rules do not supply independent patient-event gold.
reference_contracts.ACRIN_6698: Native XLSX clinical worksheet and one prepared clinical CSV, with legend kept outside source inputs. A response/QC/outcome table, not images or a paired standardized output. Missing event dates and conflicting timepoint legends remain unresolved.
reference_contracts.FLUPRINT: Raw and normalized immunology/laboratory tables with sample/participant metadata. Same underlying cohort; native-to-normalized row/unit/field correspondence has not been independently established as an evaluation oracle.

MPRINT_MAPPING.kind: advertised ZIP file, not full participant corpus

AIREADI_PUBLIC.kind: complete repository release v1.8.8 (258 files; GitHub tree sizes), rights unresolved

preaccess_license_policy.purpose: Pre-registration feasibility and terms screen, not an executed DUA, download approval or workflow AI authorization.
preaccess_license_policy.default_action: Review the exact public terms or request a sample agreement/metadata-use grant first; do not infer rights from registration, download availability or a software license.
preaccess_license_policy.lenient_rule: No explicit applicable AI prohibition passes the AI criterion only; underlying rights, platform/export, research scope, privacy and other conditions still apply. Explicit AI-specific approval is not newly required in lenient mode.

coverage.scope: Current P1/P2 entries requiring registration/access approval; families/trials can be alternatives, not independent applications. P2 remains conditional, not a decision to acquire every entry.
coverage.deferred_reason: P3 / hold; no acquisition planned for the current benchmark. Public terms not comprehensively reviewed; re-screen before any promotion or new access.
coverage.scope_note: Owner-only metadata requests have separate recorded terms needs; public_no_registration entries are not counted as registration candidates.
